request.prompt:
Create ONE native editable static SVG packed study sheet, exactly 1440 by 672, viewBox="0 0 1440 672". 3 columns by 2 rows, cells exactly 480 by 336, no gutters. Row-major order of named subjects below. Each subject MUST be an individual top-level <g id="SUBJECT-ID" transform="translate(CELL-X CELL-Y)"> using LOCAL coordinates; every group owns its own full-cell dark background rectangle. NO cross-cell content. If there are five subjects, sixth bottom-right cell stays empty dark background in a group id="unused". Keep all subject geometry at least 30 units from cell edges, major silhouette occupies 65-80% of cell. All paint definitions must be local to the group or explicit flat fills. Do not use a shared sheet-wide backdrop.

These are FUTURE EXPANSION ART CONCEPTS for later review, not canonical history or active content. This is an engraved fantasy illustration set: confident irregular contours, expressive asymmetric gestures, three broad value groups, broad sculptural material planes before detail, sparse form-following engraving, no repeated tiny decoration. Connected joinery and credible support. Upper-left light, quiet background #10232c. Ink #10232c, shadow #34464b, worn ivory #ead7b5, muted bronze #b68d62, smoky steel #95a6aa. Emberwake adds moss #7c987a, saltglass #75a99f, restrained cinder #ca7658. Night Passage patron accents: Aster warm yellow #dfc777; Neris aqua #6dbfb0; Vesta coral #d78568; Isen pale ice blue #a5cbda; Nyra restrained lavender #a18cb8. Materials must look different: wood grain follows stress, leather folds, stone thickness, translucent glass has a clear rim and broad transmission planes, metal has restrained flat highlights. No plastic gloss, no golden edge on everything. Do not turn every object into a symmetrical emblem.

Each scene reads as one distinct designed subject at 160x112 and 80x56, and should survive a 64px silhouette glance for props. This is illustration art only: no frame, captions, labels, text, digits, watermark, logo or UI. Static SVG paths and simple shapes only; no raster embedding, image, text, use, CSS stylesheets, scripts, animation, external resources or filters. No inaccessible gradient references. Economical construction with large quiet areas.

SUBJECTS in exact row-major cell order:
Cell 1: id="aster-tuning-fork"; origin (0,0); Aster tuning fork. A three-pronged bronze storm tuning fork standing in a small slate socket, unequal prong heights and one fitted wire bridge, pale gold contact tips; no lightning emblem.
Cell 2: id="neris-tide-balance"; origin (480,0); Neris tide balance. A low ceramic balance with unequal shell-shaped bowls joined by a curved bronze beam; a shallow transparent water meniscus sits in the larger bowl; aqua and dark ink.
Cell 3: id="vesta-coal-tongs"; origin (960,0); Vesta coal tongs. A pair of heavy open black iron tongs held above a shallow glazed ember dish; visible pivot and one restrained coral coal, no brazier tower or generic flame icon.
Cell 4: id="isen-stillness-chime"; origin (0,336); Isen stillness chime. Two unequal suspended blue ceramic chime slabs fitted to a low dark wood stand, one broad pale frost plane and real suspension cords; not an ice crystal or bell.
Cell 5: id="nyra-witness-mirror"; origin (480,336); Nyra witness mirror. An oval smoked silver mirror tilted in a low split basalt support, one lavender reflection plane crossing an otherwise dark mirror; beveled edge and open negative space beneath; no eye emblem.

Keep each object composition distinct, readable and structurally grounded; the five Night Passage patrons have elemental/material affinities but these objects do not claim established lore or gameplay effects.

outputs.name: Aster tuning fork
outputs.note: Unequal bronze prongs, wire bridge and connected slate foot give a clear instrument silhouette; the wire recedes at compact size.

outputs.name: Neris tide balance
outputs.note: Unequal shell bowls, curved load-bearing beam and central pivot read as a balance rather than a wave symbol. Broad aqua meniscus keeps water distinct from the ceramic rim.

outputs.name: Vesta coal tongs
outputs.note: The pivot and tool contour are readable, but the coal appears supported by only the lower jaw while the other jaw misses it; suspended action is structurally ambiguous. Retain this concept on hold, no reroll or runtime suitability claimed.

outputs.name: Isen stillness chime
outputs.note: Unequal ceramic slabs and suspended cords read clearly at native size. At 80px the thin cords recede, though the chime frame remains recognizable.

outputs.name: Nyra witness mirror
outputs.note: Tilted oval, dark reflection bands, thin silver bevel and split stone support distinguish a physical mirror from the existing eye mark. Quiet plum planes remain legible.

review_context.actual_game_ui: No supported patron-sanctum runtime content; these are 2D source concepts, not 3D prop deliveries.
review_context.aesthetic_acceptance: Four optional candidates, one structural hold. User acceptance pending. No reroll.
